mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user(id, account, name, password, email, status, create_by, create_date, update_by, update_date, del_flag) VALUES(#{id}, #{account}, #{name}, #{password}, #{email}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{createDate}, #{updateBy}, #{updateDate}, '0')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE del_flag = '0' ORDER BY create_date ASC
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE account = #{account} AND del_flag = '0'
